mapper.insert: insert into api_logs_51 ( api_url, http_method, request_content, response_content, result_code, ip_address, target_id, trace_id, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by ) values ( #{apiUrl}, #{httpMethod}, #{requestContent}, #{responseContent}, #{resultCode}, #{ipAddress}, #{targetId}, #{traceId}, getdate(), #{createdBy}, getdate(), #{createdBy} )
mapper.select: select log_id as logId, api_url as apiUrl, http_method as httpMethod, request_content as requestContent, response_content as responseContent, result_code as resultCode, ip_address as ipAddress, target_id as targetId, trace_id as traceId, created_at as createdAt, created_by as createdBy from api_logs_51 where is_deleted = 'n' order by created_at desc
